Curated 10 FatBaby observations into EMILY/BACKLOG.md INTAKE QUEUE.

Items:
- Founder real-time: make LO batteries-included -- write a Rails-like framework stdlib in LO+PARENA as a dogfooding NORTHSTAR (deferred until the emitter works); use monochrome emoji glyphs for LO stdlib naming; then continue bootstrapping the LO emitter (2026-08-30T15:57:35Z)
- Founder real-time, clarifying earlier note-versioning ask: IDUNA is the intended storage backend for note version history/content (2026-08-30T15:44:08Z)
- Founder real-time: add PARENA stdlib for date/time formatting, using the same 'magic reference time' layout string convention as Go (2026-08-30T15:41:57Z)
- Founder real-time: add PARENA primitives for managing versions of notes, plug into PAPERCRAFT -- like an iCloud-style backend for document versioning (2026-08-30T15:40:28Z)
- Founder real-time: turn 'the mag book' into a PARENA playground (2026-08-30T15:36:04Z)
- Founder real-time: proceed autonomously (yolo) on S213-03, conserve tokens; new standing instruction -- write all CHANGELOG entries in Traditional Chinese going forward (2026-08-30T15:15:32Z)
- Founder real-time, sequencing: Bazel-ize FLASH first, before other FLASH work (2026-08-30T15:07:39Z)
- Founder real-time, continued: make the USB/FLASH work in either parena or burrow (2026-08-30T15:07:28Z)
- Founder real-time, continued FLASH/parenify thread: write USB primitives into PARENA stdlib (2026-08-30T15:06:54Z)
- Founder real-time: run FLASH from Git Bash inside PITVIPER on Windows, use PARENA, get it working -- 'we forked it' (2026-08-30T15:06:01Z)
